China's 6th-gen fighter may carry laser weapons, reports suggest

China's sixth-generation fighter jets may be equipped with laser weapons capable of defending against incoming missiles, according to reports citing experts. The Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) showcased potential capabilities at the 14th China International Defence Electronics Exhibition in Beijing. These laser systems could offer a new defense mechanism for advanced aircraft.
